profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. Its website focuses on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered, unified platform for governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). The platform is available on any cloud or on-premises and takes a modular approach, allowing organizations to deploy only the components relevant to their specific risk and compliance domains. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules covering risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, which handles AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, including EU AI Act accelerators. IBM watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The broader IBM watsonx platform is described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI platform that incorporates agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also references an OpenPages MCP Server intended to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation workflows.

IBM reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, as filed in a 10-K with the SEC under CIK 0000051143 and ticker IBM. The site's held facts record 311 legal exposure entries associated with New York, though no specific case details are included in the available data.
